title: Xtreme Paintball & Airsoft
specs: Outdoor paintball and airsoft fields with custom-designed scenarios
Airsoft field covers almost 30 acres outdoor
Minimum age 10 for paintball, 6 for low impact paintball, 8 for airsoft
All players must wear paintball or airsoft mask at all times on field
No outside paintballs allowed; only field paintballs permitted
No electric hoppers allowed on Saturdays
Players under 18 must wear full-face paintball mask for airsoft; 18+ can wear full seal glasses but full face recommended
Private parties available for paintball and airsoft
Corporate events with customized packages for all team sizes
Youth groups and school events accommodated up to 60 players
includes: Field paintballs included for each rental set
Semi-auto Tippmann 98 paintball marker included in rental packages
Full face mask and barrel bag included in paintball rental packages
Airsoft rentals include BBs and tactical vest for pro package
gap: Duration of paintball and airsoft sessions not explicitly stated
blurb: Guests play paintball or airsoft in outdoor fields using rental or personal equipment. Paintball uses .68 caliber markers and biodegradable paintballs; airsoft uses replica firearms shooting 6mm BBs. Safety gear and rules are enforced; private parties and corporate events are available.
extraNote: No shooting off the field including test firing, dry firing, unloading · Removal from field for removing mask during play or aiming marker off field · Paintball can be played rain, sleet, snow, or shine but not during thunderstorms; events rescheduled if thunderstorm · If group shows up with fewer people than booked, responsible for price difference
